jobs.title: Founding Technical Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Wonka is hiring its first Technical Program Manager. You will join a Technical Program Management function that is only now being formed, reporting to the engineering leader who sponsored it. Because this is a founding seat, much of the job is deciding how large, cross-team work should be planned, tracked and shipped across a company spread over many time zones. TPMs here hold the threads between teams, keep the dependency map for our biggest bets, and set the standard for how we use our planning tools. You will enjoy this if open-ended problems energize you, you work well without close direction, and you have strong opinions about the craft.

What You'll Own

  • Work with engineering, product and design leads to shape large initiatives: pin down scope and value, get commitments from distributed teams, set dates, and carry the work from design review to launch.

  • Put in place the tracking, reporting and escalation paths that make risk and progress visible without a meeting.

  • Make launch readiness repeatable, so every team involved knows what done means before the date arrives.

  • Ask the questions that settle priority and scope, so asynchronous teams can keep moving without waiting on you.

  • Earn the trust of stakeholders by keeping goals, commitments, risks and quality in plain view, mostly through clear writing.

  • Spot bottlenecks early, lay out options for clearing them, and explain what each option costs.

  • Map how projects depend on each other and coordinate teams that do not share a manager.

  • Hold teams accountable for their own outcomes while you track, flag risk and remove blockers.

  • Learn the product and its systems well enough to be a credible member of each delivery group.

You Might Be a Fit If You

  • Have seven or more years running technical programs in software or SaaS environments.

  • Have led big multi-team software programs through to a successful finish.

  • Are at home on a remote, writing-first team.

  • Communicate clearly and build credibility quickly with engineers, non-engineers and executives alike.

  • Can drive outcomes through people who do not report to you.

  • Care about details, lean toward action, and argue from data.

  • Have the technical depth to find the risk in a plan and discuss architecture with senior engineers.

  • Have used Linear, Jira or similar tools on large programs.

What We Offer

  • Remote work from anywhere, with a coworking allowance if you want a desk away from home.

  • Equity for every employee.

  • An equipment budget for your laptop, monitor and anything else you need.

  • Health coverage for you and your dependents, wherever you live.

  • A yearly company offsite in a different city.

  • Flexible hours: you manage your own time.

  • An annual learning budget for courses, books and conferences.

About the Team

Wonka is a remote company with a globally distributed team of several hundred people across dozens of countries, backed by venture investors and a large developer community.

We move quickly, write things down, and use the product we ship.
